content_sections.heading: DLSA Gadchiroli PLV Recruitment 2026 Notification Out
content_sections.text: The District Legal Services Authority (DLSA), Gadchiroli has released the Gadchiroli DLSA PLV Recruitment 2026 notification on 05 August 2026 for 450 Para Legal Volunteer (PLV) posts. DLSA Gadchiroli PLV Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: DLSA Gadchiroli PLV Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: DLSA Gadchiroli has announced a total of 450 Para Legal Volunteer vacancies for the District Legal Services Authority and different Taluka Legal Services Committees.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Gadchiroli PLV Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Gadchiroli DLSA PLV Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the eligibility conditions mentioned in the official notification. The applicant should be a resident of the concerned working area mentioned for the post. Candidates should also have communication skills and awareness about social issues. Teachers including retired teachers Retired government employees and senior citizens MSW students and teachers Anganwadi workers Doctors and medical professionals Law students Members of NGOs Members of Women Neighbourhood Groups and Self Help Groups

rows.educational_qualification: Minimum 10th Pass qualification. Preference will be given to candidates with higher qualifications.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Gadchiroli PLV Honorarium 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Para Legal Volunteers will receive an honorarium as fixed by the District Legal Services Authority. The PLV position is voluntary in nature. It does not provide the status of a government employee, regular employment or permanent job.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Gadchiroli PLV Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in Gadchiroli DLSA PLV Recruitment 2026 must submit the application form within the prescribed time period mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Gadchiroli PLV Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for Gadchiroli DLSA PLV Recruitment 2026 will be conducted according to the rules of the District Legal Services Authority. The selection process includes the following stages: Submission and scrutiny of application forms. Shortlisting of eligible candidates. Selection by the authorized selection committee. Candidates may be selected based on their eligibility, social service background, communication skills and suitability for Para Legal Volunteer work.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gadchiroli DLSA PLV Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for Gadchiroli DLSA PLV Vacancy 2026 through the offline application process. Download or obtain the prescribed application form. Fill in all required personal, educational and professional details. Attach the required documents along with the application form. Submit the completed application form to the concerned office address before the last date. Ensure that the application reaches the office before 13 August 2026, 05:00 PM. Educational qualification certificates Residence proof Identity proof Experience certificate (if applicable) Category certificate (if applicable) Passport-size photograph Other supporting documents mentioned in the application form

faq.question: Q1. What is Gadchiroli DLSA PLV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Gadchiroli DLSA PLV Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by District Legal Services Authority, Gadchiroli for selecting Para Legal Volunteers.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Gadchiroli DLSA PLV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 450 Para Legal Volunteer vacancies are available under DLSA Gadchiroli and various Taluka Legal Services Committees.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Gadchiroli DLSA PLV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should have passed at least 10th standard. Higher qualifications will be given preference.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Gadchiroli DLSA PLV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selected Para Legal Volunteers will receive an honorarium of ₹750 per day.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for Gadchiroli DLSA PLV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 13 August 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for Gadchiroli DLSA PLV Vacancy 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by submitting the prescribed offline application form along with required documents to the concerned office before the last date.
